title: anti-ai-tell style fingerprint
description: Single source of truth for a user's chosen point of view. Positive constraints injected at generation time and used as allow/deny config by the linters. The cure for genericness is one persistent off-mode anchor; this file IS that anchor.

name.description: Human label for this fingerprint, e.g. 'mikko-portfolio'

body.description: Chosen body typeface. A non-default choice de-generics, e.g. not Inter.

accent_hex.description: The chosen brand accent. Anchors away from Tailwind indigo-500.

neutral_ramp.description: Chosen gray family, e.g. 'warm-stone' not default 'slate'.

radius.description: Corner personality, e.g. '4px' or 'sharp' or 'mixed' (not blanket rounded-2xl).

grade.description: Color grade direction; explicitly NOT orange-teal.

spec.description: Prose voice in one paragraph. For Mikko this is the ELITE voice.

distinctiveness_dial.description: Per-fingerprint default; sometimes the centroid is correct (a govt form). Overridable per artifact.
